# NCT05983237 
 
Status: RECRUITING | Phase: PHASE1/PHASE2 | Study Type: INTERVENTIONAL | Sponsor: Jun Guo 
 
Title: Fluzoparib in Combination With Camrelizumab and Temozolomide in Advanced Melanoma 
Target Enrollment: 50 
Eligible Ages: 18 Years to Any age 
Start Date: 2023-08-15 | Completion Date: 2027-12-31 
Source: ClinicalTrials.gov 
 
## Conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Melanoma 
 
## Interventions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Fluzoparib Camrelizumab Temozolomide *(DRUG)* 
 
## Summary (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
 
The purpose of this study is to evaluate how well fuzoparib in combination with camrelizumab and temozolomide works in treating patients with advanced, metastatic melanoma with the homologous recombination (HR) pathway gene mutation / alteration.
